section.p: This module guides final-year students, supervisors, academic advisors, and faculty deans through the complete thesis journey—from eligibility checks and supervisor approval, proposal and thesis progress, 3-step Yudisium clearance, to automatic placement in the nearest Graduation (Wisuda) schedule.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-secondary position-relative
div.h5: Stage 1: Thesis Registration & Choosing a Supervisor
div.p: Who performs this: Student (via Portal /my/thesis) or Academic Admin
Enter the proposed Thesis Title, select a Primary Supervisor (required) and an optional Co-Supervisor, then click Submit to Supervisor.

div.strong: System Rules & Validations (What to check if blocked):

ul.li: Active Student Only: Only students with Active status can register a thesis.

Must Pass Research Methodology First: The student must have already passed a subject marked as Research Methodology in their graded KHS. If blocked, verify that the Research Methodology grade has been entered and is passing.
Valid Supervisors Only: Supervisors must be active Lecturers, and the Primary Supervisor and Co-Supervisor cannot be the same person.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-warning position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: Assigned Thesis Supervisor(s) (Primary Supervisor & optional Co-Supervisor)

Each assigned supervisor reviews the request and clicks Approve Supervision (if a Co-Supervisor is assigned, both must approve before advancing to the Proposal stage), or clicks Reject with a written reason.

ul.li: If Rejected: The student (via Portal) or Academic Staff/Admin can return the thesis to Draft, revise the title or choose a different supervisor, and submit again.
Access Check: Only the assigned Primary Supervisor, assigned Co-Supervisor, or Campus Administrator can approve or reject the supervision request.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-primary position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: Student (logs progress) & Primary Supervisor (reviews & approves proposal)

During the Proposal stage, the student records consultation milestones, notes, completion percentage, and optional file attachments. The supervisor reviews each log (Approved or Needs Revision) and clicks Approve Proposal when ready.

ul.li: File Upload Rules: Uploaded files must use an allowed format (PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, PNG), must not be empty, and cannot exceed 10 MB.

Before Moving to Thesis Stage: To advance from Proposal to Thesis Writing, the student must already be enrolled in a Thesis subject inside an Approved or Locked KRS. If blocked here, make sure the student's KRS containing the Thesis subject has been approved by their Academic Advisor.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-info position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: Student & Primary Supervisor
The student continues logging thesis consultations and drafts until completion. When finished, the Primary Supervisor clicks Approve Thesis to move the student into Yudisium Filing.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-success position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: Student (uploads documents), Academic Staff / Admin (verifies documents), then Supervisor → Academic Advisor (PA) → Faculty Dean

ol.li: Document Filing: Upload all required Yudisium clearance documents and have Academic Staff verify them (re-uploading a file resets verification so staff re-checks it), then submit for Yudisium approval.
Step 1 — Thesis Supervisor Approval: Primary Supervisor confirms thesis clearance.
Step 2 — Academic Advisor (PA) Approval: The student's Academic Advisor confirms academic clearance.
Step 3 — Faculty Dean Approval: The Faculty Dean gives the final Yudisium sign-off.

ul.li: Complete Documents Required: You cannot submit Yudisium if any mandatory document is still unuploaded or unverified.
Strict Order: Approvals cannot skip steps—Supervisor must approve before PA, and PA must approve before the Dean.
Academic Advisor Required: If the student has no Academic Advisor assigned on their profile, Step 2 will be blocked until Academic Admin assigns one.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-dark position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: Automatic upon Dean's final approval

As soon as the Faculty Dean approves, the student's status automatically changes to Graduated and the system assigns them to the nearest open Graduation (Wisuda) batch that still has available seats. Students and staff can then print the official Graduation Clearance Sheet (PDF).

ul.li: Make sure at least one upcoming Graduation Schedule is created, marked Open, and has available quota before the Dean approves Yudisium.
